title: Soft-tissue chin profiles in aesthetically normative facial features: comparison of three-dimensional camera with two-dimensional radiography
html: Preoperative chin profile assessment in orthognathic surgery remains limited by reliance on two-dimensional (2D) cephalometric standards. Advances in three-dimensional (3D) facial scanning allow comprehensive, multi-dimensional evaluation of soft-tissue facial morphology; however, evidence-based aesthetic assessment of normative chin profiles using three-dimensional facial imaging remains limited. Hence, this study aimed to investigate soft-tissue chin profiles in clinically aesthetically normative participants using a 3D camera system, comparing with traditional 2D cephalometric values.
